record.one_liner: Airtable is a cloud platform combining spreadsheet-style databases with apps and automations for organizing and managing team data.
record.auth_notes: Personal access tokens (created at airtable.com/create/tokens, scoped to chosen scopes and bases) sent as Authorization: Bearer. Enterprise admins can create service-account tokens. OAuth2 grant flow for third-party integrations; register the integration at airtable.com/create/oauth. The legacy API key was not covered by the pages fetched, so I did not verify its status.
record.access_notes: PAT creation is self-serve. The fetched PAT page does not state plan requirements, and the rate-limits page says limits may be tiered by plan, so free-plan API access is inferred, not confirmed. The MCP support page lists availability as "All plans". OAuth registration showed no review step, but a privacy policy and ToS URL are needed before other users can authorize the integration.
record.blocker: Rate limits: 5 requests/sec per base and 50/sec per user/token, with a 30s wait after a 429. Airtable may change limits and may tier them by plan. Free-plan API access is not explicitly confirmed. Breadth is inferred from the token scopes and the Metadata API mention, and I did not review the full endpoint list.
